review.notes: Triage review within a fixed budget. Machine-scanned all 86 physical pages: full-document normalized 4-gram containment of PDF page text in the OCR markdown flagged 13 low-hit pages, and each was classified - physical pages 36, 49, 52, 55 and 58 are chart/figure pages (Figures 6, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17) whose numbers exist only inside the embedded images (captions and image embeds verified present; not droppage); the rest are HTML-table pages (Tables 3, 8 and the safety/distillation tables) where tag words break 4-gram alignment, and distinctive values (e.g. Codeforces ratings 1444/1534/1687/1746/2029, cons@64, AlpacaEval2.0, MMLU-Redux 92.9) were confirmed present verbatim. Full-document code-fence balance scan found the decisive structural defect: OCR emitted four-backtick lines where the print shows three (and inflated four Example fences to six), leaving an unclosed fence that swallowed everything after the middle of Listing 2 - all benchmark and appendix tables, listings 4-10 and the reference list rendered as one code block. The repair normalizes printed ‘‘‘ fences to three backticks, removes fences the print does not have (page-break artifacts on physical p.23/24, the doubled fence before </ASSISTANT>, the stray fence before "In addition..."), and re-lengthens the two Listing 2 box-boundary fences to four backticks so the printed literal three-backtick transcript lines stay literal. Pages 22-25 were additionally rendered and visually inspected at 300 dpi to confirm every patch; the remaining pages were machine-scanned without line-by-line reading. Physical page 33 was also rendered to confirm the spurious fence before the Listing 7 caption.

unresolved.evidence: The large benchmark and safety HTML tables were confirmed present with spot-checked values via the automated scan, but no full cell-by-cell comparison against the rendered pages was performed within the budget.

Later appendix listings contain literal ```markdown lines inside open code blocks (e.g. the markdown lines that remain literal inside a ``` block after the repair). They balance under the applied repair, but the box-boundary representation of those listings was not re-derived from renders.

Chart-internal axis ticks and data labels are absent from the OCR text by design (the figures are embedded as images with captions); only the interleaving order of the few extracted fragments was not reviewed.
